title: Auction Games
description: After finishing her meal, Ningguang is worried about the auction that her secretaries are in charge of, and so you go to inspect the site with her. What's got her all concerned, you wonder?

flow.stepDescription: Go to the site where the auction is being held

dialogs.text: Anything Lady Ningguang used to own is sure to be worth a significant amount of money.
So even if the price is a little inflated, it should still be fine...
Did you bring plenty of Mora with you?
Let's put it this way — anything you can snag in one of Lady Ningguang's auctions is practically Mora in the bank. The more you take home, the bigger your fortune.
Hmm, I can't see anything that particularly interests me...
Lady Ningguang must know what she's doing though. I'm sure she has her reasons.
Thank you for your custom.

dialogs.text: Huh? You want to know why I paid so much?
Well, it's pretty obvious, isn't it? Because the previous owner was Lady Ningguang.
Sure, the item might look pretty ordinary, but that's probably just because I'm not a connoisseur, so I don't know how to appreciate it...
But I figured I'd buy it first, then go get it appraised by an expert. Then I'll be rich! Hehe...
I may have paid an arm and a leg for this, but in the end I got the result I wanted. Hahaha.
Aren't you worried about the price being over-inflated?
Nothing of Ningguang's could ever be over-inflated.
I'm far from the only buyer who believes that "owned by Ningguang" is worth paying a premium for. So how much I make just depends on how many people are even bigger fans of Ningguang than I am!
*sigh* Today wasn't my day. Didn't manage to snag much.
There were too many bidders, and they all seemed like experts to me.
I guess I'll just have to wait for the next auction. Someday, I'll be the lucky one.
Go ahead and talk to the buyers. They'll give you the answers you're looking for.
